answer: Witnesses must come from clusters that share nothing. The lotus records which cluster each staker belongs to, and a newcomer may trade only after stakers from distinct clusters each lock 5 opal behind it, forfeited if it forges a result. Bridge links keys whose payouts ever merge, and an operator's k-th key needs k clusters that have backed none of its earlier keys. An honest newcomer needs one stranger's 5 opal. A 30-key operator must win over 465 separate clusters, bribing each staker to risk opal on a clone it cannot vet.
